versions.changelog:
everything-search-v1 0.1.0

- Initial release of a local file search skill for Windows 10/11 & WSL2, powered by the Everything es.exe CLI tool.
- Provides fast file name/path/size-based searches (not full-text or web search).
- Features human-readable output, support for common Everything search syntax, Chinese encoding correction, and privacy-focused operation.
- Automatically detects and starts Everything/es.exe in the background if needed.
- Results are returned in formatted tables with user-friendly size units.
